response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience, which makes him drastically overqualified and mismatched for an entry-level Junior Java Developer role. His deep expertise lies in TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and full-stack/embedded systems rather than Java, and his German is only basic, falling short of the strong bilingual communication requirement for client-facing insurance consulting work.
strengths: Extensive real-world software development experience across many domains
Strong familiarity with agile practices, TDD, CI/CD, and modern cloud/dev-ops tooling
Some direct Java experience (robotic arms, device orchestration tools) and computer science degree
concerns: Vastly overqualified seniority level (Staff/Senior) for a junior entry-level position
German is listed as only 'Basic', not meeting the strong communication requirement
Career focus is on TypeScript/Node.js/DLang rather than Java, indicating skill mismatch
